concerns.text: The methodology states that yield‑strength data will be downloaded from open repositories (Materials Project, NIST HEA database, or Matbench). However, the Matbench HEA benchmark does not contain experimentally measured yield‑strength values, and many entries in Materials Project lack mechanical testing data. Relying on these sources without guaranteeing the presence of the target variable makes the validation of the predictive model impossible, rendering the experimental design unable to answer the research question.
